Title: LEGO DUPLO 10450 Hopsy's Castle Game, Age 3+, Building Blocks, 2025 (47pcs)
Body HTML:
Enjoy hours of family fun with your toddler as you help them learn through play with the LEGO® DUPLO® Hopsy’s Castle Game (10450) 2-in-1 board game. Toddlers embark on a LEGO DUPLO learning adventure, practicing counting and color-sorting skills while playing one of 2 fun games. First toddlers use number and colors skills to build a creative castle toy. This fun family activity starts by each player picking a toy animal then spinning the arrow to see how many places on the board they can move. They then add to the model one brick with the color they landed on. The game ends when all the characters arrive at the castle. In game 2, toddlers use color sorting to see who can build the tallest toy tower. Players spin the arrow to see which color brick they can add to their building toy. This educational toy features a raft of learning activities, such as understanding turn-taking, being imaginative and using fine motor skills to build creatively or working as a team to complete the castle.
